body:
Raise TICKET_BODY_CAP in packages/parallax/lib/prompts.mjs from 8000 to 64000 so parallax --edge inspects the same 64000-character prefix that coldstart approved.

Acceptance criteria:
1. TICKET_BODY_CAP equals 64000 and effectiveTicketBodyCap validates positive integer caps with fallback to TICKET_BODY_CAP. Verify: node --test packages/parallax/test/prompts.test.mjs
2. Ticket bodies up to 64000 chars are embedded whole without truncation markers while 64001 chars are truncated to the opening 64000 chars. Verify: node --test packages/parallax/test/context-fencing.test.mjs
title: parallax: align edge review TICKET_BODY_CAP with coldstart 64000 char cap (#1196)
